description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class, which hosts the Navigation Component and BottomNavigationView to manage navigation between different screens such as Dashboard, Insights, and Settings in an Android application. It sets up navigation using fragments and establishes the MVVM architectural pattern.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends AppCompatActivity and manages the app's navigation interface, integrating fragment navigation and bottom navigation view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up navigation components including the NavController and BottomNavigationView.
